channel.title: PAGASA NCRPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NCRPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 10:00 PM, 29 October 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over Greater Metro Manila Area(Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna and Cavite) within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 13 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 13-Final #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 29 October 2026(Thursday)

All Rainfall Advisory over NCR-PRSD forecast area are now TERMINATED.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 1:15 PM, 29 October 2026(Thursday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Quezon (Macalelon, San Narciso, Mulanay, Pitogo, Gumaca, Lopez, Guinayangan, and Calauag) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Quezon (Catanauan, General Luna, and Buenavista) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 12 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 12 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 29 October 2026(Thursday)

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains are expected over Quezon(Tiaong, San Antonio, Dolores, Candelaria, General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Sariaya, Lucena, Tayabas, Pagbilao), Tarlac(La Paz, Concepcion, Victoria, Tarlac City) and Bulacan(San Miguel, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray).

Light to moderate rains affecting Batangas(San Juan) and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Gabaldon, Zaragoza, Licab, Santa Rosa, Penaranda, Laur, Palayan, Quezon, Santo Domingo, Talavera, Aliaga, Cabanatuan) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
